events.name: New York Jets at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Matt Forte scored three touchdowns and Ryan Fitzpatrick finally solved Rex Ryan's defense, leading the New York Jets to a 37-31 victory over the Buffalo Bills on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Forte scores 3 TDs to help Jets outlast Bills

headlines.description: Joe Flacco threw two touchdown passes to wide receiver Mike Wallace and the Baltimore Ravens rallied from a 20-point deficit and beat the Cleveland Browns 25-20 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flacco rallies Ravens to 25-20 win over Browns

headlines.description: Marcus Mariota converted a fourth down with a perfectly lofted 9-yard pass to Andre Johnson with 1:13 left, lifting the Tennessee Titans to a 16-15 win over the Detroit Lions on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans rally to beat Lions 16-15 on Mariota's 2nd TD pass

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Jimmy Garoppolo had three, first-half touchdown passes before leaving in the second quarter with a right shoulder injury as the New England Patriots outlasted the Miami Dolphins 31-24 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots' Garoppolo injured, still beat Dolphins 31-24

events.name: New Orleans Saints at New York Giants

headlines.description: Eli Manning hit Victor Cruz on a third-down 34-yard pass to set up a winning field goal and the Giants got off to their first 2-0 start since 2009 with a 16-13 win over the Saints.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eli to Cruz sets up Giants win again, 16-13 over Saints

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger threw for 259 yards and three touchdowns to offset a pair of interceptions and the Pittsburgh Steelers beat the Cincinnati Bengals 24-16 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers grind their way past Bengals 24-16

headlines.description: Alfred Morris scored the go-ahead touchdown on a 4-yard run with under five minutes left Sunday, leading the Cowboys to a 27-23 victory over his former team, the Washington Redskins.
headlines.shortLinkText: Morris' TD after Cousins' INT leads Cowboys past Skins 27-23

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw for 353 yards and four touchdowns, and the Carolina Panthers overcame four turnovers to beat the San Francisco 49ers 46-27 on Sunday in their home opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton sets TD passing mark, Panthers down 49ers 46-27

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Houston Texans

headlines.description: DeAndre Hopkins had 113 yards receiving and a touchdown and Nick Novak kicked four field goals, helping the Houston Texans to a 19-12 win over the Kansas City Chiefs on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Novak makes 4 field goals, helps Texans beat Chiefs 19-12

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Greg Zuerlein kicked three field goals and the Rams defeated the Seahawks 9-3 on Sunday that marked the return of pro football to Los Angeles for the first time in nearly 22 years.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams beat Seahawks 9-3 on Zuerlein's leg in NFL return to LA

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: Carson Palmer threw for 308 yards and three touchdowns and the Arizona Cardinals intercepted Jameis Winston four times in a 40-7 rout of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Palmers throws for 3 TDs, Winston picked off 4 times in rout

headlines.description: Von Miller gave the Denver fans a reminder of his Super Bowl 50 MVP performance by sweeping in for a strip-sack of Andrew Luck to seal the Broncos' 34-20 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
headlines.shortLinkText: Miller's sack-strip leads Broncos past Colts

headlines.description: Justin Hardy caught a deflected 8-yard touchdown pass to break a tie midway through the fourth quarter and the Atlanta Falcons held on to beat the Oakland Raiders 35-28 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons use deflected TD pass to beat Raiders 35-28

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Philip Rivers matched his career-high with four touchdown passes, including two to Travis Benjamin, Melvin Gordon ran for one score and had his first 100-yard game in the San Diego Chargers'  38-
headlines.shortLinkText: Rivers throws 4 TD pass as Chargers rout Jaguars 38-14

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: Sam Bradford had a Minnesota debut almost as dazzling as the new $1.1 billion building itself, completing 22 of 30 passes for 286 yards and two touchdowns to lead the Vikings to a 17-14 win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bradford leads Vikings over Packers 17-14 in Minnesota debut

headlines.description: Carson Wentz followed up an impressive NFL debut with another solid performance, throwing for 190 yards and a touchdown, and the Philadelphia Eagles beat the Chicago Bears 29-14 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wentz comes through again as Eagles beat Bears 29-14
